def clip_black_by_channels(color, threshold):
    """Replace any individual r, g, or b value less than threshold with 0.

    color: an (r, g, b) tuple
    threshold: a float

    """
    r, g, b = color
    if r < threshold: r = 0
    if g < threshold: g = 0
    if b < threshold: b = 0
    return (r, g, b)
